the pulverized compound was alight and the incindagel burned so hotly that even the supposedly inflammable materials were burned away to naught but ash and dust nothing had tried to escape the inferno though the platoon had been thorough lieutenant george called up demolition confirmed no contamination present at site a copy that lost boys actual be advised supply drop incoming at planned coordinates somebody tell me you sent coffee down with the rest of the supplies lieutenat george grumbled only if supcom changed the standard loadouts of lsv resupply pods the communications officer replied chipperly damn lieutenant george sighed ill have to ask the locals good icebreaker mister diplomat laugh it up vacpeddler will check in after contact with locals lost boys actual out copy that lost boys actual keep your boots down and your heads up down there alright everybody lieutenant george told his men we have maybe an two or three hours of good daylight left lets try to meet the locals in it some acknowledgments rolled in and they began a power armor assisted lope toward landfall at increasing speeds until they fell into a comfortable forty miles an hour despite the planetary biospheres relative youth the forest they moved through was a blend of mighty oaks and scrubby deciduous trees and shrubs and the further they got from the ashes of site a the more signs of wildlife they encountered that is until they began to encounter signs of civilization roads snaked along the hills small farmsteads nestled into hollows in the trees and isolated cabins overlooked their lonesome domains but these outposts of civilization were empty the people had wisely retreated to landfall or else they had fallen where they stood their ground the shadows were long and the sky was painted a vibrant orange by the time the settlement came into view settlement was perhaps an uncharitable description city was more fair and fortress may apply the forest abruptly ended in a rough ten mile circle around the city and a short mile from the treeline farmland spread out beneath the open sky looming towers stood vigil over the crops and pasture keeneyed frontiersmen with their hunting rifles could exact a price on any trying to cross the open ground and more importantly could offer warning to the civilians the towers were an obvious recent addition their gleaming metal supports betrayed as much but theyd been there long enough for the farmers to adapt to them the towers and their watchmen were hardly landfalls only defense a gray blastcrete wall already marred by scorch marks rose from the fields to conceal and protect the city behind like the hulking shoulders of a giant gates yawned open around its ringing defense and roads spoked out of the ring into the farms and the forests beyond landfall had prepared itself to hold out the telltale whistlecrackbooms of drop pods snapped through the air and a spray of dirt along the treeline a mere quarter mile from lieutenant george and his platoon spoiled the feeling of peace balanced on the brink of violence somewhat maybe we should ask the mister smee to balance it out and make it symmetrical again lance corporal tanaka suggested the point is for lt to get them to pack up private jamal adebayo pointed out somehow corporal barrett began i figure that these folks will be mighty reluctant to leave maybe so lieutenant george agreed but we dont abandon our people and we dont leave them without choices technical peel out some greaseballs and set them to assembling our vehicles and night camp someone see what our boat put in the pods for dinner and get it hot and at least edible if you dont have something to do in those two tasks form up twoman patrols and range out around the circle and make sure that there isnt anything trying to sneak up on us i want all three of our scouts to grab some mres and a spotter and press on to site b youll have to set up your own camp and catch a little sleep while the rest of us catch up before he was finished speaking the relevant troopers began following his orders and he found himself standing alone as a beatup ground truck kicked up dust along a road as it drove directly for him while it was still a couple miles off he could use his augmented left eye to zoom in on the driver and get a good look at him an older human man somewhere past fifty his sunreddened face looked like it was used to smiling the man wasnt smiling now his thin lips were set in a grim line his green eyes flashed with determination and worry wrinkled his brow to furrow new lines in his balding pate lieutenant george set his helmets faceplate to transparent and consciously kept his expression neutral professional at length the ground truck slowed to a stop and the man heaved himself out into the open air he wore overalls over stocky legs and his arms and shoulders were thick with muscle and this close lieutenant george could see the scars and calluses on the backs of his hands and palms respectively good evening he said politely to the man as he stumped up to stand before lieutenant george with his arms folded defiantly i know who you are oathkeeper the man said bluntly please call me jason lieutenant george said with no less cordiality than his greeting and the man seemed taken aback for some reason and you have me at a disadvantage sir dont sir me i work for a living the man said reflexively then darkened with embarrassment er the names sergeant jackson sergeant earl jackson retired sir rni no sir army youre a citizen while im a serviceman but i understand sarge lieutenant george said as he let himself faintly smile i take it youve organized these defenses yes that i have yes could i be so fortunate to be speaking to the man who can get me some damn coffee sergeant jacksons reserve broke and he threw his head back to roar with sudden laughter it looked and sounded natural after long seconds the old man at last reined himself in to say aye sir lets get you and your men some coffee damn navy still wont send it down with you selfish bastards lieutenant george agreed but after coffees sorted out id like to talk to your civic leadership if that isnt you fuck no it isnt me im not that unlucky were going to set up camp out here so as to not impose on your fine city lieutenant george began but sergeant jackson inturrupted him dont be silly we have plenty of room inside the wall besides just because you took out the enemy base doesnt mean you want to pass up on a bed much obliged sergeant ill let my men know and id appreciate it if you could arrange a meeting with civil leadership what do you have here a city council aldermen mayor and council sergeant jackson corrected proudly ill see about you talking to both thanks again sergeant with that lieutenant george stepped away to speak with sergeant drilldrai on their private channel the local militia leaders invited us inside the walls for the night but i dont want to take advantage of these peoples hospitality we cook our dinner here first and the men shall make it clear that theyve already eaten before accepting anything offered no drinking but ill let them accept sealed containers to enjoy once were shipboard aye sir lieutenant drilldrai acknowledged before she reported the lsvs are nearly assembled we can load up the rest of the supplies and drive them in any idea what kind of hospitality were getting the sergeant promised beds but frontier folk tend toward generous good news she breathed i dont know about you but i hate sleeping in my armor stop whining and see to the men lieutenant george scoffed it looks like the militia leader has news about the meeting i need its not whining its complaining sergeant drilldrai retorted and aye sir turning back to sergeant jackson lieutenant george asked whats the word the word is they want to meet asap the grizzled fronteersman grumbled as if you dont have shit to do the downside of silver bars is talking to the big wigs is part of my shit to do my platoon sergeant has things under control here i could hitch a ride in your truck bed if youd be so kind no problem the old man said hop on one ride into town later and lieutenant george was pleasantly surprised to find that sergeant jackson was true to his word and had stopped at a local coffee house presumably the old mans favorite chuckling to himself he gave the locals something of an unusual show and rni trooper exiting his armor the hiss of breaking seals the whirring of little servos and the armors back opened up as he disengaged the helmets lock and placed it on the truck cabs roof for safekeeping then he slid his arms free of the armor and hauled himself up and out into the briskly cool air of the planets local spring then clad only in his tightly fitting power armor piloting suit he strode into the coffee house after his host as he shook his shortened scarlet braid free of his neck smells like heaven he declared as a little brass bell chimed in the doorway above him and the quiet hum of the coffee house fell to total silence lieutenant george bore their stares in stride as he padded up to the counter and politely said i didnt bring any cred chits down with me but ill happily pay any bill hell the mister smee will probably cover it now if you ring her up you you you the cashier a ruddy skinned fair haired human girl in her late teens stammered you are the oathkeeper no charge lieutenant george put on his most disarming smile and said please im just another trooper doing his job you can call me jason really its no trouble to pay i dont mind no charge she insisted her eyes wide with scandal i havent even said what i want yet oh yeah uh can i i mean may i take your order mister oathkeeper i mean jason aye i would like a double espresso please coming right up it wont take long at all dont worry huh sergeant jackson mused and lieutenant george saw a considering light behind his keen eyes he decided to let the old man consider shortly thereafter lieutenant george found himself in the passenger seat of sergeant jacksons truck with the nectar of the gods cupped in his hands he sipped at it gratefully as he waited for the old frontiersman to say what was on his mind the old man seemed reluctant to speak however and the trooper was content to steal the seconds of pleasure where he could find him that is until it seemed to lieutenant george that the retired soldier might burst so at last he asked alright what is it nothing sergeant jackson gruffly grunted his already ruddy skin reddening further before he amended its just youre not what i expected i get that a lot im sorry i didnt mean that nothing about expecting you to be full of yourself or the old man spun his hand in the air over his stearing wheel as if trying to grasp what he meant as he trailed off or a battlehardened hero of the republic stalwart and brave the aging soldier snorted derisively before he admitted yes and no i guess youre stalwart and brave under action i guess i was too i just got here sergeant youve been fighting for at least two months yes sir i guess i am too sergeant jackson admitted but thats not what i men youre patient gentle i didnt expect that i expect you know what happens when men like us fail to be patient to be gentle when its called for yes sir i do youre just lieutenant george let a sad smile grow as he inhaled the soothing scent of strong coffee then he said try not to feel sorry for me sergeant ive made my choices and i dont regret them the old soldier considered as he pulled to a stop before the grandly built city hall with its grecian columns and brazen dome before he at last said just so you know no matter what some of us wont go this is our dirt i cant promise much lieutenant jason oathekeeper george told the man solemnly but i can promise you that ill tell command what i think of your defenses unshed tears shone in the grizzled soldiers eyes as he choked ill leave the truck here my place isnt that far i dont guess anybody would mess with your armor the meeting was not being held in the mayors office but rather the meeting hall within city hall and it was arranged in the usual way for republican civic chambers that is like an arena stadium seating rose toward the edges of the domed ceiling to loom with vague hostility or suspicion over the floor in an encircling ring leaving the only escape a tunnel built through the seating thus forcing the officials to enter and exit under the watchful eyes of any citizens or civilians who cared to scrutinize the proceedings the floor itself was comprised of a wide open green carpeted space occupied by a long desk with eleven seats arranged in a omega shape so that the councilors and mayor could look at one another while the public in turn watched over their shoulders and so that there was a gap in the desk for use by people bringing propositions or presentations before the city lieutenant george strode directly into the center and saluted the mayor blinked at him for a moment then she remembered that as the civic leader she outranked him here and so stood to return the salute thank you for coming lieutenant she said as she took her seat again and lieutenant george stood at attention word had apparently gotten around since people were filing into the seating through doors near the top of the ring worried people careful people curious people quietly and politely sorted themselves out into the seats but the flow of onlookers from the doors kept on steadily as lieutenant george that blunt facts would be the best approach madam mayor ladies and gentlemen of the city council citizens and civilians of the republic it is my duty to inform you of certain facts and of the recommendations of the republican government as the duly elected representatives of the city of landfall we are prepared to be appraised of the situation and the recommendations of terra proceed lieutenant aye first some good news by tomorrow afternoon your fine world of jefferson will no longer play host to enemy installations the nearer of the two has been reduced to ashes on the wind excited chatter rose from the ring of onlookers even while more and more people joined them and a few even whooped joyously at the news once they quieted down again lieutenant george continued it is an unfortunate fact that we shall depart by that time as well along with the rvn destroyer our platoon is attached to where are you going a young voice from the crowd demanded hotly were going where the lost boys are always going to pull somebody out of trouble were the only ones who were fast enough and hard enough to pull you out of your predicament before it got started and we arent a garrison force furthermore first fleet is stretched thin defending our outer core worlds and third fleet is just as thinly stretched trying to put pressure on the controllers in their territory what about second then one of the councilors interjected lieutenant george looked into the middlaged doggo mans brown watery eyes in silence until the other man quailed and looked away scum and villains take the war as an opportunity to expand their trades pirates smuggles gangsters and others are making so much work for the second fleet that command is working on getting a fourth fleet founded these are facts that you could have found out for yourselves except of course our ongoing operation to cleanse your planet another fact that you are no doubt aware of is that you do not have any sysec an angry buzzing interrupted him and he simply stood at attention and waited for the people to quiet down again when they did he told them if it werent for the grubs and their controllers you could get along without it just fine until you had the population to support an orbital space station if it werent for the war the problem is that you cannot fight at all until the enemy is on the planet and even then they can get dug in and equipment down before you find them therefore the republic of terra and her aligned planets recommends that the people of jefferson pursue a policy of general evacuation absolute pandemonium erupted from the packed stands men shouted and shook their fists women shrieked and spat insults and lieutenant george caught a few phrases as he stood at attention with out so much as twitching or furrowing his brow my mother is buried here and my farm and my grandmother bred the oaks for this world and various other objections centered around the communitys roots going deep despite its relative youth meanwhile the councilors ran the spectrum from hostile stubborn refusal to queasy realization while the mayor stared at lieutenant george in slackjawed shock at length she was recalled to her duties and began to bang the gavel on its wooden anvil demanding order order order until the crowds fury reluctantly subsided into a sullen semblance of conforming with her demand once they at last did she said you cannot order us to leave our homes aye maam that is true the republic of terra and her aligned planets has no authority to forcibly relocate any of her civilians or citizens she cannot and will not become a tyranny even in the face of this awful enemy i have merely laid out the facts to you some you should have known some you have ignored even now in your dire peril you remain free men and women you are the masters of your own destinies and i cannot and will not abridge that if my own personal recommendations matter to you i will add this the land can be retaken the farms and city can be rebuilt he pointed to an infant in the crowd and said that is irreplaceable the next morning sergeant drilldrai drove one of the three newly assembled lsvs out of one of the city gates despite most people getting a look at the shiny new wheeled vehicles manned by incongruously battlescuffed powerarmored men that hadnt stopped a small crowd from following them on their way out gravdrives were more versatile than electric motors turning actual wheels but they were notoriously fragile from the perspective of orbital dropped equipment tracked vehicles were also out of the question too bulky and too heavy hence light squad vehicles kicked up dust with their cellular tires as they gained speed once they were outside the walls it was time to get back to work did you get an answer she asked lieutenant george the lieutenant performed an unnecessary check on his sidearm in the passenger seat beside her before he answered no they were still debating what to do when i checked in this morning any updates from orbit the hypercom relays back up the mister smee put some detection satellites orbiting some of the other rocks insystem to hopefully give the locals some advanced warning when the grubs come back sergeant drilldrai grunted noncommittally its not as simple as you think try and imagine if the we sing couldnt move and someone came along and told you youd have to leave her to be taken by the enemy this planet is like that for these people planeters sergeant drilldrai scoffed but her heart wasnt in it she understood she just didnt like the thought of people getting killed because the republic couldnt get there to help quickly enough she couldnt see it behind lieutenant georges opaque faceplate but she got the sense he was grinning at her she elected not to say anything as she lead the platoon off the road and began to drive through the woods unsurprisingly the settlers hadnt built a road to the enemy installation so the local sun was high overhead by the time theyd come upon the coordinates where theyd determined to leave their lsvs and rendezvous with the scouts sergeant drilldrai brought the lsv to a gentle halt and the other two vehicles came to similarly gentle stops a short distance behind then they dismounted to meet pfc raj patel pfc reyes pfc kim and their spotters alright whats the word lieutenant george asked the word is that the enemys riled up like a kicked anthill pfc reyes snarled theyve got patrols out their kamikaze drones are already in the air they have laser emplacements up and energized they intend to make us pay for it dont they know the enemy only exists to be destroyed the lieutenant asked but nobody finished the saying this enemy would never stop being the enemy what are you thinking actual sergeant drilldrai asked im thinking that theres no good reason to charge a fortified prepared position manned by alert enemies when i can call the mister smee and get a little cas to drop some ordinance on their heads instead that sounds like a great thought sir pfc patel said emphatically a very good thought indeed while the lieutenant was coordinating with the mister smee sergeant drilldrai got the platoon moving she understood full well that after the navy dropped some warheads on foreheads theyd have to move in and mop up to that end she sent delta squad to set up their ordinance on a bluff overlooking the facility and had alpha and beta squads creep through the trees and shrubs as close to the milling mass as they reasonably could at a full sprint theyd be among the four bulbous buildings in under a minute by the time they were all in position atmospherecapable attack craft screamed overhead they were already launching missiles that billowed trails of smoke behind them like the wings of avenging angels before the highpitched whines of their engines caught up to them along with their sonic booms hellfire rained down on the distillation in the blink of an eye and the craft were already climbing back to their ship in orbit thousands of tiny kamikaze drones detonated by way of chain reaction laser platforms overloaded and erupted and grub victims dropped to the ground as their controllers perished in the conflagration while others fired wildly into the sky in a hopeless gesture of futile rage even as the enemys attention was skyward the whole of the platoon opened fire without mercy riflemen and saw operators cut down the grub victims where they stood while the heavy ordinance teams of delta squad pulverized what was left of the buildings until the last of the victims fell either due to their controllers being killed or the grim work of alpha and beta squads the world went silent then after a few heartbeats lieutenant george ordered into the stillness burn it the remains of the grub controller invasion force smoldered sullenly at the platoons backs as they rode their lsvs to the pickup point just outside of the citys supporting farmland nobody had anything to say on the ride sergeant drilldrai could spare one hand to rest on her cousins shoulder she knew theyd celebrate their victory later but none of them would feel like they could until they were all shipboard again the locals might or might not appreciate the lsvs that were being left behind or they might be left behind again soon in any case sergeant drilldrai didnt dwell on it overmuch she simply hoped that theyd see some use by good republican people either way they might appreciate the aa shotgun and rni standard service rifle that she forgot in the lsv along with all of the other forgotten weapons the mister smee would be able to replace them so cheaply it woudlnt even make a new line item on the budget they filed into the shuttle just as soon as its side doors slid open she wasnt surprised to find lieutenant george offering a comforting hand on her upper shoulder as he reported in this is lost boys actual platoon all present and accounted for on pickup no casualties some minor equipment losses first previous next

i was gifted a nissan about 10 months ago i was gifted the ultimate gift a 2014 nissan versa note sv with 55k miles a squeaky drive belt and cvt fluid that was never changed this versatile compact hatchback once belonged to my mother who decided to stop driving and just gave it to me i accepted the car because my wife now commutes farther from the city and needed a car to do so and so i gave her my model 3 tesla in order to get to work and personally settled into the versa for my short commute to work within just a few weeks i noticed people tailgating me as if i was slowing everyone down going 35 in a 55 which i was of course due to safety concerns people even began honking at me while i almost backed out of a parking spot into another car a few times it took me 7 months to realize there is a backup camera on the radio display i would just have to keep my lights turned off so there would be enough electricity running to the display to power it and make it bright i just wish people would be more careful its really their fault for not respecting my swift but powerful little nissan backing out i also noticed how efficient the car was at selfdriving like my tesla but without the software setting the cruise control to 85 on the highway and using my knee to steer while running a youtube video on my handheld phone or checking out google maps all of this while running my mp3 tunes off the usb memory stick at full volume to tune out the wind drag noise and rattling body panels at 85mph however it did make me feel pretty important and significant knowing that my large 14l engine was not only heard by me but also everyone on and off the road within a 3mile radius running at 8000rpm but at the same time variably switching to 3000rpm because of cvt one of nissans greatest gifts to humanity i believe my car is potentially a gateway to another dimension while taking 8 hours to change the rear license plate due to the easy access to the mounting screws the trunk door hit me a few times as it dropped on my head without a warning since the telescopic arms that hold it up leaked its gas a few years back the third time it hit me i was able to see an astral projection of the future where all humans drive a nissan and the world becomes a safer place and ac units are not an option or feature of these vehicles over the 10 months of being a proud nissan owner i developed an urge to buy a second car for myself preferably a used altima at an 38 apr for 96 months i recently stopped paying my credit card bills and loans in order to make that dream happen i truly believe nissans are the best and this is hard for me to say as i used to own a daewoo lanos many years ago which arguably was the best car in america for a short period of time i have to unfortunately end this post early my car is calling me i need to find more cvt fluid for it igor tldr get an altima

copper is not just a conductor it is the cooling and connectivity layer behind ai modern machines and aerospace most people think of copper as the wire in the wall that is true but it is incomplete copper matters because it solves three problems at once moving power moving heat and keeping highspeed systems electrically stable when you look at ai infrastructure cars and aerospace copper shows up as the enabling layer more than the headline component start with ai data centers the obvious use is power delivery busbars highcurrent cabling grounding and distribution inside the facility but the less discussed part is copper as a thermal and mechanical solution when you pack gpus densely and push power harder heat becomes the real ceiling copper heat sinks cold plates and copperheavy cooling loops help pull heat out of chips and into a system that can reject it without aggressive heat removal you cannot run sustained workloads at high utilisation and uptime becomes fragile there is also a connectivity angle people miss modern ai training is not one gpu it is thousands acting like one supercomputer that requires extremely reliable lowloss interconnects and stable power environments fiber is great for data links but you still need copperheavy infrastructure to deliver clean power ground noise and support the physical interconnect ecosystem that turns racks into a single compute fabric copper is part of what makes scaleout computing stable rather than chaotic now zoom out the same physics show up in consumer pcs vehicles and aerospace chips do not just need electricity they need heat removed copper heat spreaders connectors wiring harnesses and cooling components show up across everything from gaming pcs to ev power electronics to avionics in cars copper is everywhere in motors inverters wiring and thermal paths in aerospace and satellites copper is used despite weight constraints because reliability and signal integrity are nonnegotiable once systems are deployed this is why copper demand can be structural it is not just more devices equals more wire it is that higher power density and higher performance requirements increase the need for copper in cooling grounding and connectivity for a balanced way to express that theme in markets you can layer exposure producers like freeportmcmoran nyse fcx bhp nyse bhp asx bhp and southern copper nyse scco offer direct operating exposure explorers like rumble resources are upstream optionality plays cse rb often shown as rbn on yahoo finance and are higher risk but they exist because future supply has to come from somewhere rbs investor presentation is available on the company website when you think about copper demand do you focus mostly on electrification wiring or do you think cooling and ai infrastructure end up being the bigger hidden driver not financial advice

copper is shifting from a cyclical metal to a strategic security asset copper is no longer just another industrial commodity it is steadily becoming a strategic material and the demand trajectory makes that clear global copper consumption is currently around 25 million metric tons per year forecasts suggest demand could reach 3335 mt by 2030 4045 mt by 2040 and potentially 5055 mt by 2050 in practical terms the world would need to build the equivalent of a second global copper industry within the next few decades this demand surge is not driven by a single theme but by overlapping structural forces electrification artificial intelligence and defense modernization traditional internal combustion vehicles use roughly 2025 kg of copper electric vehicles require closer to 6085 kg representing a 200300 percent increase ev adoption is expected to rise from under 20 percent today to more than 60 percent by 2040 with scenarios approaching 80 percent or higher by 2050 that shift alone could add 710 mt of annual copper demand by midcentury the buildout of charging infrastructure further compounds the issue as fast chargers and grid upgrades require significantly more copper than legacy systems the electrical grid itself is another major source of pressure much of the us grid was built 4070 years ago and is not designed for largescale electrification or highdensity computing loads copper demand tied to grid modernization is estimated at about 12 mt annually today with projections rising to roughly 20 mt by 2035 and potentially 2530 mt by 2050 this represents a 100150 percent increase driven by ev adoption ai data centers and militarygrade power redundancy ai infrastructure and defense systems add another layer that is often overlooked a single hyperscale data center can consume between 2000 and 5000 tons of copper and power intensity continues to rise global datacenter electricity usage is expected to more than double by 2030 and keep climbing thereafter copper demand associated with data centers and defenseoriented computing could grow from under 1 mt per year today to 5 mt or more by midcentury on the supply side constraints are significant bringing a new copper mine into production typically takes 1020 years at the same time ore grades have declined materially from about 12 percent in the 1990s to roughly 06 percent today requiring far more material to be processed for the same output meeting projected 2050 demand could require 300350 new mines globally or cumulative capital investment exceeding 250300 billion the us currently produces around 11 mt annually supplying only about half of its domestic needs these dynamics explain why copper is increasingly discussed in the context of supplychain resilience industrial policy and national security copper is a core input for satellites radar systems secure communications naval platforms and aienabled command and control infrastructure by 2050 copper demand tied specifically to defense applications is expected to be 253 times higher than today from an investment perspective this supports a layered approach rather than a single exposure major producers such as freeportmcmoran nyse fcx bhp nyse bhp asx bhp and southern copper nyse scco offer direct leverage to copper supply and pricing further upstream are earlystage explorers that represent future supply optionality rumble resources which trades as rb on the cse and appears as rbn on yahoo finance is positioning itself as a copperfocused canadian explorer its investor materials outline efforts to advance projects in a market that increasingly values longdated supply if copper demand is set to double by 2050 while supply growth remains slow and capitalintensive the question becomes whether markets will begin pricing copper less like a cyclical metal and more like critical infrastructure not financial advice

congo minister says investment list coming to washington this week congo plans to present washington with a catalog of mining opportunities this week as the central african nation moves forward with a december partnership agreement designed to attract american capital to its resource sector louis watum the countrys mines minister disclosed the timeline during remarks on wednesday at the future minerals forum in riyadh speaking six weeks after both governments formalized their strategic arrangement we are sending this week to the us a list of strategic projects where the us can invest watum told attendees its going to be strictly speaking a commercial discussion its not going to be like we are giving it for free not at all the initiative builds on the december 4 washington accords an arrangement that positions us corporations ahead of competitors in accessing congos copper cobalt lithium and tantalum deposits president donald trump has prioritized securing mineral supplies for electric vehicles military hardware and advanced technologies as washington works to reduce its reliance on chinese supply chains chinese firms operate 15 of congos 19 coppercobalt operations and command 80 of the countrys cobalt output according to mining industry reports the african nation supplies more than 70 of global cobalt demand the us international development finance corporation is negotiating 1 billion in backing for two initiatives a coppercobalt trading partnership between stateowned gecamines and swiss commodity trader mercuria energy trading plus rail infrastructure that would link congo to atlantic shipping routes through angola american mining interests have already established a foothold kobold metals which counts bill gates and jeff bezos among its investors the phantom cabinet 2 chapter 3 part 2 sure carter had felt no small measure of guilt after abandoning his only childparticularly after a dishonorably discharged exmarine murdered douglas in front of the oceanside credit unionbut his selfreproach was more than offset by the relief and relaxation he attained with a specterfree existence nights of lovemaking with elaina segued to unbroken sleep strangers and acquaintances were far friendlier without ghost boy around he still visited his sons grave at timeless knolls memorial park twice a year on douglas birthday and christmasspeaking to the corpse underfoot as if it could hear him and actually cared about the trivialities of carters lifebut he possessed not one photograph of douglas and barely remembered what hed looked like so too did he eschew any documentation of his time with martha his first wife as with douglas grave however he began to visit martha from time to time seated at her bedsidein her cramped milford asylum room with an orderly lingering in the hallwayhe attempted to coax signs of awareness from the nonresponsive soothingly he spoke of bygone days the years theyd been so in love of pancake breakfasts and formal events and snuggling on the sofa lost in each others presences exasperated he elaborated upon douglas two deaths demanding that she let the past go so as to heal her broken mind contrite he explained his acquisition of a doctors certification which attested that marthas mental state was unlikely to get better any time soon which hed use to file for a divorce later hed told martha of his marriage to elaina no response a malignancy seemed to churn unseen in the shadows around her carters skin crawled in marthas presence had she suddenly shrieked he might have leapt out of it twice hed been dominated by her rooms blighted atmosphere seizing martha by the shoulders hed shaken her wake up damn you hed hollered as her head flopped fore and aft unresponsive until hed been pried away from the woman and escorted from the asylum with threats of lost visiting privileges sounding hollowly in his ears it had been nearly seven months since his last visit hed been meaning to make the drivehad made appointments in his head and skipped them repeatedlybut was too comfortable in his suburban husband routine the milford asylum experience was akin to enduring the same opencasket funeral over and over carter always drank a few shots of jameson beforehand to steel his resolve and afterward got entirely blotto so as to sleep within marthas withered slack features he saw what remained of his younger selfs naive notion of starting a family all of douglas lost potential was interred there as was every bit of the love that carter had felt for the two of them if she ever emerged from her catatonia hed have to explain their divorce hed have to make martha understand that theyd never live together again even if she regained mental health hed attempt to be her friend in some nebulous way though the sight of her sickened him hed been in the delivery room when shed throttled their newborn after all that memory had never slipped from his mind fortunately for carter his days as an air conditioning engineer were long behind him a few weeks after douglas was laid to rest he ridded himself of every item remaining in his unoccupied home from the comics beneath his dead sons bed to the bed itself from the plantation shutters to the refrigeratorselling certain objects giving away others driving the rest to the landfill while cleaning out the house working long hours solo carter was astounded to find the place warm and stuffy neither cold spots nor winds of unknown origin conjured shivers no phantoms capered in his peripheral vision no mouthless voices made him revolve toward empty space still he wished to be rid of the residence as any good memories associated with it had long since been swallowed by the bad ones selling the home for six figures had gone smoothly enough setting a portion of those funds aside for elaina and his weddinghed yet to propose at the time but certainly planned tohe decided to quit his job and live off of the rest but uninvested currency is lazy currency as many well know and succumbing to the preoccupation of most men finding his days otherwise rudderless carter yearned for greater financial success with neither of them working elaina and he often sniped at one another and bore grudges over the most trivial matters if he couldnt find a solitary way to spend his time to counterpoint those many minutes they spent together their relationship would sour thus he turned to longdistance real estate investing home prices being far too high in california for his liking carter contacted a floridabased real estate agent to whom he explained his intention of purchasing a home in need of light renovations hiring a contractor to fix it up then flipping the residence for a fast profit he made sure to emphasize the fact that should the agent produce a lucrative recommendation carter would be sure to turn to him for future property purchases by the end of that day not only did carter have a halfdozen properties to choose from complete with background info such as neighborhood crime rates and proximities to schools and shopping centers but he had the names and phone numbers of the same number of contractors all of whom the agent swore were bastions of integrity and costeffectiveness eventually after much hemming and hawing carter settled on a twobedroom onebathroom jacksonville residence for his inaugural investment studying photos his real estate agent emailed him he decided that the place needed a paintjob roof retiling a marble backsplash in the kitchen a new refrigerator and oven and tile flooring to replace its cheap linoleum he contacted the nearest three contractors for cost and time estimates and settled on the cheapest fastest responder a few months later carter had successfully renovated and sold the place for a profit of nearly 100000 without ever setting foot in the state of florida realizing how easily he could make money without leaving his housewhile wearing pajamas all day long if he desired tohe was hooked initially focusing his efforts on a single house at a time so as not to be overwhelmed he went from city to citytampa fort lauderdale west palm beachselecting properties in need of light renovations accruing profits from each the vital repairs varied sometimes doors toilets or cabinets needed replacing occasionally lighting was the issue when a place otherwise rendered homeownerfriendly still lacked a certain je ne sais quoi he sprung for nonessential upgradesskylights heated flooring accent wall stoneworkto improve its wow factor and reduce its time on the market years passed and eventually carter turned his eye to midwestern states ohio indiana and missouri abhorring the idea of dealing with property managers and tenants on a regular basis he avoided the steady stream of income that renting properties might have provided buy renovate flipbuy renovate flip profit kept inflowing elaina and carters joint checking and savings accounts swelled naturally they purchased new vehicles a mercedesbenz eclass for carter a bmw x5 for elaina their wardrobes improved as did elainas jewelry collection they dined out often and tipped generously better yet were the frequent vacationshawaii new zealand mallorca belize paris jamaica french polynesia and othersduring which they immersed themselves in tourist attractions and offthebeatentrack experiences comfortable enough in oceanside they spoke not of relocating to a more affluent socal city instead carter and elaina spent lavishly to enhance their own home upgrading their appliances to topoftheline equipment was only the beginning a crocodile leather sofa now occupied their living room facing an entertainment center whose pice de rsistance was an eightysixinch 4k television its sound thundered and screeched from a 4000 wireless surround sound system a matching tv could be found in their bedroom which they watched from their duxiana bed they replaced every inch of their flooring with porcelain tiles with electric underfloor heating keeping their feet warm at all times they replaced their countertops with granite and added undercabinet lighting in the kitchen in their backyard they shelled out over 100000 for an inground pool and jacuzzi complete with a waterfall and breathtaking rock formations neither of them swam much but they climbed into the jacuzzi at least once a week typically with beer bottles or wine glasses in their hands their 10000 american muscle grill evoked the 1969 shelby gt 350 mustang it had been modeled after indeed if they lacked any creature comforts the stantons were unaware of them with myriad channels to choose from hundreds of social media acquaintances and the means to visit any location on earth any time they desired to rarely did they feel boredom or jealousy their rambunctiousbutadoring canine a corgi named maggie more than made up for their lack of children they attested walking her once a day inspired them to exercise rather than succumb to the antisocial tendencies that afflict many individuals of advanced age they maintained shallow friendships with half a dozen local couples hosting and attending dinner parties with what are the ai applications in transportation ai applications in transportation artificial intelligence ai has become a transformative force in the transportation industry driving innovations that enhance safety efficiency and sustainability with the increasing demand for smarter mobility solutions and the rise of connected infrastructure ai technologies such as machine learning computer vision and predictive analytics are reshaping how people and goods move around the world from autonomous vehicles to traffic management and logistics optimization ai is unlocking new possibilities below are the major ai applications in transportation 1 autonomous and selfdriving vehicles one of the most widely recognized applications of applications of artificial intelligence in transport is the development of autonomous or selfdriving vehicles ai systems use sensors cameras radar and lidar to perceive the surrounding environment detect obstacles and navigate safely machine learning algorithms process vast amounts of realtime data to make driving decisions such as braking accelerating or changing lanes advanced computer vision helps these vehicles recognize traffic signs pedestrians and road conditions selfdriving cars and trucks have the potential to reduce human error which is a major cause of accidents and improve road safety and traffic efficiency 2 traffic management and smart signals urban areas struggle with congestion and ai is being used to optimize traffic flow aipowered traffic management systems analyze realtime traffic data from sensors cameras and gps devices based on this analysis adaptive traffic signals can adjust their timing dynamically to reduce bottlenecks and waiting times at intersections predictive models forecast traffic patterns helping city planners plan road maintenance or diversions to minimize disruptions by reducing congestion and travel time ai enhances urban mobility and lowers fuel consumption and emissions 3 predictive maintenance of vehicles and infrastructure maintenance is critical in transportation and ai enables predictive maintenance to reduce breakdowns and costs sensors embedded in vehicles trains and aircraft collect data on engine performance brake wear tire pressure and other parameters ai algorithms analyze this data to detect early signs of wear and tear or mechanical failure maintenance can then be scheduled proactively reducing downtime and extending the lifespan of assets this approach enhances safety lowers operational costs and ensures higher reliability in transportation systems 4 logistics and supply chain optimization ai is revolutionizing logistics which is central to transportation ai systems optimize delivery routes by analyzing factors like traffic weather and road conditions in real time machine learning models forecast demand enabling more efficient inventory management and warehouse operations ai can also automate scheduling fleet management and cargo tracking as a result goods are delivered faster fuel usage is reduced and companies can cut operational costs while improving customer satisfaction 5 public transportation planning public transport systems benefit greatly from aidriven planning and optimization ai models analyze passenger data ticket sales and travel patterns to forecast demand at different times and locations transport agencies can use this data to adjust bus or train frequencies improve route planning and minimize overcrowding aibased systems also provide realtime information to passengers about schedules delays and seat availability this enhances the efficiency of public transit networks and improves the commuter experience 6 safety and accident prevention safety is a critical concern in transportation and ai contributes by preventing accidents and enhancing response ai systems in vehicles can detect driver fatigue distraction or intoxication through facial recognition and behavior analysis collision avoidance systems use ai to identify hazards and automatically apply brakes or adjust steering to avoid crashes ai also helps analyze accident data to identify highrisk areas and improve road design or signage these measures reduce accidents injuries and fatalities on roads railways and airways 7 autonomous drones and aerial transportation ai is also enabling new forms of transportation such as drones and aerial taxis aidriven drones are used for lastmile delivery surveillance and traffic monitoring they navigate autonomously by using gps sensors and computer vision systems to detect obstacles and avoid collisions in the future aipowered passenger drones or air taxis could provide rapid urban transport reducing congestion on roads this represents a new frontier in transportation where ai is central to innovation 8 environmental sustainability and energy efficiency ai contributes to making transportation more environmentally sustainable ai systems can optimize driving behavior like smooth acceleration and braking to lower fuel consumption in electric vehicles evs ai manages battery performance and predicts optimal charging times to extend battery life ai also supports ecofriendly route planning by avoiding congested areas and reducing idle time this helps cut greenhouse gas emissions and supports global sustainability goals 9 smart ticketing and passenger experience ai is improving the passenger experience through automation and personalization aibased smart ticketing systems allow contactless payments dynamic pricing and automated fare calculation personalized travel recommendations are generated using data on user preferences and past travel behavior ai chatbots and virtual assistants provide realtime support for booking route guidance and issue resolution these innovations make travel more convenient and userfriendly encouraging the use of public transportation read also benefits of ai in the food industry

a comprehensive guide on buying a second hand motorcycle this will be a very long read so get ready as someone who has already purchased three used motorcycles i wanted to share my experience with new riders making their first purchase i learned mostly through trial and error dealing with incomplete documents hidden mechanical issues and sellers who werent always transparent those experiences taught me how to be more careful observant and confident before handing over my money i wished someone would have guided me on this but unfortunately i have gone over so many headaches trying to figure out and sort bullshit from the previous owner that i thought it would be great if new riders have the comprehensive guide based on my experience so that they dont have to learn the hard and expensive way its written especially for firsttime buyers who want to avoid costly mistakes understand what really matters during inspection and walk away with a motorcycle thats both legal and safe to ride on philippine roads whether youre buying your first bike for daily commuting or weekend rides the goal is simple to help you make a smart informed decision and enjoy riding with peace of mind so lets start 1 choosing the right motorcycle for you no motorcycle is perfect there are shit ones there are good ones what matters is that the motorcycle must fit your riding style not the other way around before searching decide what type of motorcycle fits you best choose between manual and automatic based on your comfort and riding environment manuals are usually more fuelefficient and cheaper to maintain while automatics are easier to ride especially in heavy traffic then think about your purpose for daily commuting prioritize reliability comfort and fuel economy for weekend or fun rides you might value power and riding experience more also consider where youll be riding most of the time city streets provincial roads and highways all demand different things from a motorcycle knowing these early will narrow your options prevent impulse buying and help you choose a bike youll actually enjoy owning brand choice also matters generally its advisable to buy from the big japanese four honda yamaha suzuki or kawasaki these brands are known for reliability durability and longterm performance though they can be more expensive upfront there are budgetfriendly options like rusi bajaj or motorstar but you can often feel where costcutting was done whether in materials refinement or longterm reliability there are also reliable nonjapanese brands worth considering such as sym kymco and ktm which offer good build quality and performance depending on the model when it comes to parts availability and ease of maintenance honda and yamaha stand out as replacement parts are widely available almost anywhere in the philippines in most popular models every motorcycle even the most expensive ones have their own fair share of problems and issues so you have to research which one you really want 2 search for your new motorcycle you finally decided that you want to buy the best and greatest motorcycle of all time the suzuki burgman the next question is simple but important where do you actually find one the safest option is always to buy from someone you already know this could be a friend a coworker or a family member who no longer needs the motorcycle and is looking to let it go buying from someone within your circle gives you a huge advantage because you already have an idea of how the motorcycle was used and maintained you can ask honest questions about past repairs accidents or recurring issues and if something goes wrong after the purchase you still have a way to follow up with the seller that peace of mind alone is often worth more than finding the cheapest deal online if that option isnt available the next place to look is good old facebook marketplace it gives you access to a wide range of listings allowing you to compare prices and conditions easily however this is also where you need to be extra careful avoid listings with prices that seem too good to be true as these are often tied to serious issues such as missing documents motorcycles that are talon casa or repossessed units or even vehicles that were previously flooded flooddamaged motorcycles can look fine on the outside but may develop electrical and engine problems over time avoid xerox orcr you must have complete and original papers you may come across listings that mention open deed of sale or open dos this means the current seller bought the motorcycle from the original owner but never transferred the ownership to their own name while this setup is common it already adds an extra layer of risk personally i would advise avoiding motorcycles that are not being sold by the original owner once a unit has passed through multiple hands it becomes harder to trace its full history some owners take good care of their motorcycles but others dont and theres no easy way to know what the bike has been through an open deed of sale can also lead to serious headaches later on especially during transfer of ownership or if legal issues arise in worstcase scenarios problems such as stolen units or disputed ownership become much harder to resolve when the paper trail is incomplete or unclear when browsing marketplace take your time and dont rush into a deal ask clear questions request proper photos and always inspect the motorcycle in person a cheap price is never worth the risk if it comes with legal or mechanical problems with patience and caution facebook marketplace can still be a reliable place to find a good suzuki burgman without unnecessary headaches 3 inspection of motorcycle and documents congratulations you found a seller and are meeting up with them to finally buy it you agreed on a reasonable price and bothered your local bank to withdraw stacks of your hard earned money but what now lets split this into two paperwork inspection and vehicle inspection 31 vehicle inspection 311 physical inspection this is where you slow down and become very observant starting with a physical walkaround of the motorcycle begin by inspecting the motorcycle from all angles look closely at the fairings body panels handlebars foot pegs and exhaust scratches are normal for a secondhand motorcycle especially those used for daily commuting small scuffs and faded paint usually fall under normal wear and tear however you should be cautious of deep scratches cracked panels bent levers or mismatched parts as these may indicate that the motorcycle has been involved in an accident or has nasemplang before pay attention to areas that typically hit the ground during a fall such as the handlebar ends mirrors brake and clutch levers foot pegs and engine covers excessive damage in these areas may suggest a hard impact rather than a simple tipover also check if parts look newly replaced while surrounding areas appear old as this could be an attempt to hide previous damage the odometer is not always a reliable indicator especially if the seller is dishonest some sellers highlight a very low mileage to make the motorcycle more attractive but odometers can be tampered with one way to crosscheck this is by looking at the tires motorcycle tires typically last anywhere between 5000 and 15000 kilometers depending on riding style and road conditions if the tires appear to be the original stock tires and the tread wear is still reasonable the claimed mileage may be accurate on the other hand if the tires are no longer stock it could suggest that theyve already been replaced which may indicate higher usage that said tire replacement by itself isnt automatically a red flag some stock tires wear out quickly or perform poorly so owners often replace them early the key is to use the tires as a reference point rather than a final verdict and to check if the overall condition of the motorcycle aligns with the mileage being claimed take your time during this stage and dont let the seller rush you a careful visual inspection can reveal a lot about how the motorcycle was used and maintained if something looks off or inconsistent trust your instincts and ask questions its always better to be cautious early than to deal with costly repairs later 312 indepth mechanical inspection once youre done with the initial walkaround its time to focus purely on the mechanical condition of the motorcycle at this stage youre checking whether the bike is safe functional and properly maintained not just goodlooking start with the starting systems if the motorcycle has a kick start make sure it works and doesnt feel unusually heavy or loose a healthy engine should start without excessive effort the electric starter should also work consistently slow cranking repeated clicks or needing multiple tries to start may point to battery starter or electrical issues move on to the chain for manual motorcycles check the chain tension and condition it shouldnt be overly loose or too tight and it should be properly lubricated rust stiff links or uneven wear can indicate poor maintenance and may mean the sprockets also need replacement inspect the front shocks by pressing down on the handlebars and watching how the suspension responds the shocks should compress smoothly and rebound without bouncing look closely for oil leaks along the shock tubes as leaking seals will affect ride quality and safety check the wheels and tires next spin the wheels to see if they rotate smoothly without wobbling bent rims uneven rotation or unusual resistance can signal past accidents or hard impacts tire tread should still be in decent condition and sidewalls should be free from cracks or bulges examine the rear shocks by sitting on the motorcycle and observing how it settles the suspension should support your weight and return smoothly weak or leaking rear shocks can make the bike unstable especially on rough roads test the brakes carefully the front brake should feel firm and responsive not spongy the rear brake should engage smoothly without excessive travel any grinding noises weak braking or inconsistent response are serious safety concerns check the battery condition and mounting the battery should be secure with clean terminals and no corrosion electrical issues often start with a neglected battery inspect the engine oil level and condition oil that is extremely dark gritty or milky may indicate poor maintenance or internal engine issues check all cables including throttle and clutch cables they should move smoothly without sticking or fraying stiff or damaged cables can fail unexpectedly look over the wiring especially under the seat and near the handlebars wiring should be neat and intact exposed wires loose connections or messy electrical tape jobs are signs of careless modifications finally test all lights make sure the rear brake light works when either brake is applied the front brake switch activates properly and all signal lights blink correctly these are basic safety and legal requirements a motorcycle that passes these mechanical checks is far more likely to be reliable and safe saving you from expensive repairs and unnecessary stress after the purchase 313 test rides for manual motorcycles pay extra attention to the clutch and transmission pull the clutch lever and make sure it moves smoothly without stiffness during a test ride shifting should be smooth across all gears difficulty shifting slipping gears or the bike lurching when engaging first gear may point to clutch or gearbox problems also inspect the clutch and throttle cables closely they should not be frayed stiff or sticky for automatic motorcycles especially scooters with cvt systems the test ride is crucial when you twist the throttle acceleration should be smooth and consistent jerking hesitation or delayed response can indicate worn cvt components such as the belt rollers or clutch listen for unusual noises like rattling whining or grinding coming from the transmission area especially during takeoff and deceleration pay attention to how the motorcycle behaves at low speeds an automatic should creep smoothly without sudden surges vibrations during takeoff or shuddering when slowing down can be signs of a worn clutch assembly also observe engine braking when you release the throttle it should feel natural and predictable not abrupt or absent finally make sure the idle is stable when stopped if the engine stalls revs too high or feels inconsistent after a short ride it could point to tuning fuel or transmissionrelated issues a smooth quiet and predictable ride is what you want from a healthy automatic motorcycle 32 document inspection once you complete the mechanical inspection it is time for the document inspection now you have to be very vigilant here a mechanical problem can be fixed a fuckedup document will fuck you up in order to fix it you have to go through ltos lengthy and expensive process or participate in corruption through fixers both can be avoided through due diligence at a minimum you should require the original copy of the certificate of registration and the original copy of the official receipt these documents prove that the motorcycle is legally registered and eligible for transfer youll also need two copies of a valid id from the original owner along with three specimen signatures which are commonly required during ownership transfer a properly notarized deed of sale is essential as this formalizes the transaction and protects both buyer and seller additional documents such as insurance papers the original sales invoice or casarelated documents are optional but helpful while not always required they add another layer of verification and can make future transactions or registrations easier lets break down what to look for in these documents so you dont get duped 321 authenticity of papers when inspecting the documents start by checking the authenticity of the certificate of registration itself this may sound simple but the physical feel of the cr can already tell you a lot an original lto certificate of registration is printed on security paper it should feel slightly thicker and more textured than regular bond paper when you run your fingers across it it shouldnt feel overly smooth or flimsy fake or reproduced crs are often printed on ordinary paper and feel too thin or too clean look closely at the print quality the text should be sharp and consistent not blurry or pixelated check for uneven fonts misaligned text or spelling errors which are common signs of forgery also inspect the color and layout original crs follow a standard format and anything that looks off should raise concern examine the document for signs of tampering erasures smudges corrections or overwritten details are red flags pay close attention to the engine number chassis number and owners name these fields should be clean and uniform without signs of alteration its also important to be aware of the cr format motorcycles purchased before 2021 typically have the older yellow index cardsized certificate of registration motorcycles purchased after march 2021 use the newer fullpage cr which is blue in color both formats are valid but knowing this helps you avoid confusion or being misled during inspection trust your instincts during this step if the document feels wrong or looks suspicious its better to walk away than to risk dealing with fake or problematic papers later on 322 validation of details now that you have verified that the document is authentic its time to do your due diligence on the paperworks certificate of registration start with checking if the motorcycles plate number and cr plate number are the same make sure the series model color year and makebrand are the same as the one you are currently buying check the or and cr and cross check if the file number are matching then you proceed to engine number and chassis number these are very important as you will not be able to transfer your motorcycle to your name if there are discrepancies here each motorcycles have different location for these so look it up online before buying it in the burgman 125 the chassis number can be found underneath the seat make sure it matches the one in your cr and or to find the engine number it can be found inwell the engine tilt your motorcycle 45 degrees and you should be able to find an embossed number make sure this matches with the cr and or next verify that the owners name on the certificate of registration matches exactly with the name on the valid id presented by the seller spelling middle initials and suffixes should all be consistent any mismatch even if it seems minor can cause issues during the transfer of ownership and may require additional documents to resolve check the address as well the address indicated on the cr should match the address on the owners id while small differences in formatting are usually acceptable completely different addresses can be a red flag and should be clarified before proceeding lastly look for the encumbered to field on the cr and make sure it states na this indicates that the motorcycle is fully paid and not tied to any loan financing company or mortgage if the motorcycle is encumbered it cannot be legally transferred until the encumbrance is officially cleared which can involve extra steps time and expense making sure this section is clean will save you from serious complications later on original receipt after checking the cr move on to the official receipt the or confirms that the motorcycles registration fees were paid and that the registration is up to date first check that the name on the or matches the name on the certificate of registration this helps confirm that the documents belong to the same motorcycle and owner next look at the expiration date to see whether the registration is still valid or already expired an expired registration isnt necessarily a dealbreaker but it does mean additional costs and penalties on your end dont get caught driving it expired as that is a 10000 pesos ticket finally review the payment details on the or make sure that the motorcycle information listed there such as the plate number and file number matches whats written on the cr if the name validity period and details all align then the or is in order and you should be good to go deed of sale the deed of sale is usually prepared and notarized at a notary publics office however in reality many transactions happen in residential areas parking lots or public places in these cases either the buyer or seller may already have a deed of sale form fill in the details on the spot and leave it unnotarized for the meantime while this is common its not ideal personally its best to have the deed of sale notarized during the meetup itself if possible notarization adds legal weight to the document and protects both parties the cost is usually shouldered by the buyer and rates vary per office most notaries charge a percentage of the declared sale price rather than a fixed fee the process is straightforward if youre buying directly from the original owner both parties simply sign the document in front of the notary have it notarized and the transaction is complete problems usually arise when the motorcycle is being sold with an open deed of sale in these cases many legitimate notary offices will refuse to notarize the document if the original owner is not physically present this is because the document states signed before me meaning all parties must personally appear before the notary this is where alice guos lawyer got screwed over during the senate hearing this is where things enter a gray area you may find small stalls or offices that offer cheaper notarization services even without the original owner present these are often not lawyers themselves but the notarization still appears valid because it is done under a licensed lawyers name while this practice is common it exists in a legal gray area and carries some risk make sure all the details are correct some notary offices are sloppy and get the details wrong happened to me id and signature this part requires extra diligence any mismatch between the signature on the deed of sale and the signature on the owners id can result in your transfer being rejected if that happens you may be forced to track down the original owner and execute a new deed of sale which can be difficult or sometimes impossible if the motorcycle passed through multiple owners ive personally encountered this issue before the original owner was an indian national and the lto rejected the transfer due to a mismatch in signatures we couldnt find any online records or contact information for him which made the situation even more difficult it took several months of effort to finally track him down in another region fortunately we were able to execute a new deed of sale and only then were we able to successfully transfer the motorcycle to my brothers name make sure to get clear photocopies of two valid ids from the registered owner and check that neither id is expired the name and signature on these ids should closely match what appears on the deed of sale have the owner sign three specimen signatures on the copies of the ids these signatures are used by the lto to verify authenticity during the transfer process taking time to do this properly can save you from serious delays and headaches later on after you have paid everything and signed all the paperworks it is advisable that the seller and you buyer have a picture together holding both your id and while you are signing the documents not really a requirement but a good common practice to have incase lto came asking questions happened to us just another proof and layer of legitimacy if youve made it this far and followed each step carefully congratulations youve done the hard part you didnt rush you didnt cut corners and you took the time to inspect both the motorcycle and the documents properly that alone already puts you ahead of a lot of buyers who end up learning these lessons the expensive way at this point you should be confident that the motorcycle youre buying is mechanically sound legally clean and worth your hardearned money from choosing the right bike avoiding sketchy listings inspecting the unit doing a proper test ride and validating every piece of paperwork youve set yourself up for a smooth ownership experience now all thats left is to enjoy it ride safe ride responsibly and take pride in the fact that you bought your motorcycle the right way whether its for daily commuting or weekend rides may your bike serve you well and give you many kilometers of stressfree riding welcome to the road wag maging kamote next episode comprehensive guide on how to transfer your motorcycle tbd
